head_coach.name: Julian Nagelsmann
head_coach.play_style_summary: Relies on high-intensity gegenpressing, territory-based defensive blocks, positional interchanging, spatial manipulation, and possession dominance through a double-diamond build-up structure.

key_players.name: Florian Wirtz
key_players.performance_stats: In his debut 25/26 season for Liverpool, he adapted to a more physical style, playing 49 matches, creating high-value chances, and executing tactical half-space runs.

key_players.name: Jamal Musiala
key_players.performance_stats: After recovering from a broken fibula that sidelined him for months, he showed incredible form in the second half of the 25/26 season with elite dribbling and chance creation.

key_players.name: Joshua Kimmich
key_players.performance_stats: Serving as Germany's captain, Kimmich completed 50 games for Bayern Munich in the 25/26 season, displaying unmatched passing precision, high defensive recovery rates, and key playmaking contributions.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Muscle fibre tear in the back of his left thigh
